description: Source code for the ClientInfo class in the Google Breakpad crash reporting system, handling process crash info, memory management, and custom data collection on Windows.

classes.name: ClientInfo
classes.description: Manages crash report data, process handles, and custom info for a client process in crash generation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes process handle and event handles for crash reporting.

methods.name: UnregisterDumpRequestWaitAndBlockUntilNoPending
methods.description: Unregisters dump request wait handle, waiting for pending callbacks to finish.

methods.name: UnregisterProcessExitWait
methods.description: Unregisters process exit wait handle, optionally blocking until no callbacks are pending.

methods.name: GetClientExceptionInfo
methods.description: Reads exception info from the client process memory.

methods.name: GetClientThreadId
methods.description: Reads thread ID from the client process memory.

methods.name: SetProcessUptime
methods.description: Calculates and sets the process uptime in custom info entries.

methods.name: PopulateCustomInfo
methods.description: Reads custom info entries from the client process memory and adds uptime info.

methods.name: GetCustomInfo
methods.description: Returns custom info including process uptime.
